name: SAI Pro
technique: Rug pull; Liquidity drain; Exit scam
rootCause: SAI Pro was reported as a BNB Chain rug pull on 2023-11-23 after the deployer removed PancakeSwap liquidity, with public pages putting net user loss at about 751,627 USDT. The deployer retained unilateral control over the liquidity position and could remove it after buyers had entered the pool. No contract vulnerability has been established in the available record.
